attributes.name: [Elastic Cloud] First-seen identity sign-in
attributes.description: An identity authenticates for the first time in 7 days, after the stream has at least a day of history.

investigation_guide.blob:
## First-seen identity

The identity's earliest sign-in in the 7 day window is in the last hour. The rule stays quiet until the audit stream itself is at least 24 hours old, so a new install does not alert on every identity.

### Triage
1. Open **[Audit] Identity 360** for this identity.
2. An identity that was idle for 7 days and then returned also matches.

### Tuning
Widen the rule window to lengthen the baseline.

esqlQuery.esql:
SET unmapped_fields = "nullify";
FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-*
// History is the whole stream, not only sign-ins, so platform traffic can satisfy the 24 hour guard.
| INLINE STATS oldest = MIN(@timestamp)
| WHERE oldest <= NOW() - 24 hours
| WHERE event.action == "authentication_success"
| WHERE authentication.type IS NULL OR authentication.type != "internal"
| EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name)
| WHERE actor IS NOT NULL
| EVAL actor_kind = CASE(user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", "cloud_api_key", user.email IS NOT NULL, "user", api_key.name IS NOT NULL OR authentication.type == "api_key", "api_key", "principal")
| WHERE actor NOT IN ("elastic.maintenance", "autoscaling", "elasticsearch-controller", "elastic/fleet-server", "elastic/kibana")
| STATS first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), successes = COUNT(*) BY actor, actor_kind
| WHERE first_seen >= NOW() - 1 hour
| SORT first_seen DESC
| LIMIT 100
